# CloakSight — Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixtures for unit and integration tests.

## Contents (to be added in Phase 2+)

- `dom-snapshots/` — Sample PageSnapshot JSON objects for testing DOM parser and PII detector
- `receipts/` — Synthetic receipt images for OCR testing
- `action-plans/` — Sample ActionPlan JSON objects for testing action dispatcher

## Privacy Note

All fixtures must use **synthetic data only**.  
No real names, real Aadhaar numbers, real bank accounts.

Use generated/fake data that follows real format patterns.
